# Will your strategy pass the challenge, and is the fee worth paying?

> Simulate a funded-trader evaluation with your own win rate, reward:risk and risk per trade. Pass probability under a profit target, daily loss limit and static or trailing drawdown, expected fees to pass, funded payouts and the break-even win rate. Free, private, in your browser.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
